name: AMI
source:
After moving from the countryside, Kanou Ami couldn't seem to get used to attending a new school.
One of her classmates, Imanishi Sei, noticed she's always alone and decided to befriend her.
However, there are quite a few girls who don't seem too happy about him spending time with the transfer student...

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040322234427/http://www60.tok2.com/home/yuuki0413/game-ami.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
从农村搬来后，加纳亚美似乎不太适应去新学校。
她的一位同学今西清注意到她总是孤身一人，并决定与她成为朋友。
不过，也有不少女孩子对他和转校生在一起的时光不太高兴……

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040322234427/http://www60.tok2.com/home/yuuki0413/game-ami.html]官网[/url]]
